summary.name: Egirls.ai
summary.one_liner: Egirls.ai is an adult-only AI companion platform for chatting with NSFW AI characters that remember users, generating images and video, making voice calls, and talking with live 3D AI VTuber avatars.
use_cases: Adult roleplay and AI sexting with fictional characters
Long-running companionship with one AI character
Collaborative fiction that runs over weeks
Generating images of characters from chat
Designing and publishing custom AI characters
Talking to a live 3D anime avatar by voice
summary.what_it_does: The site offers text chat with AI characters that the page says are written with personalities and situations, and that keep user details such as name, preferences and past conversations across sessions. Users can generate images and short video of characters from within the chat, and each character has a voice for phone-style calls. Some characters are rigged as real-time 3D avatars that speak and react. Users can also build their own characters by setting a personality, appearance and situation, then keep them private or publish them to the public catalogue.
notable: Persistent memory across sessions, on by default and tied to the account
Live 3D AI VTuber avatars that respond by voice in real time
Character creator with option to publish characters to a public catalogue
Chat works without sign-up; free account lifts message limit
caveats: Image and video generation requires an account
Heavier use of generation and voice features is covered by paid plans
Free use without an account has a message limit
